summary: A side-by-side UTV with two occupants became stuck and partially submerged in the Arkansas River near Ruby Mountain Campground off County Road 300 in Buena Vista on August 3, 2025; the river began sweeping it downstream before it hung up on a rock. Colorado Parks and Wildlife used swift-water rescue techniques to remove both occupants, who were uninjured; the UTV was pulled out with a tow truck. The driver was arrested for DUI after investigators found driving into the river was an intentional act.
location: Arkansas River near Ruby Mountain Campground, County Road 300, Buena Vista
responding_agency: Chaffee County Sheriff's Office; Colorado Parks and Wildlife
notes: Borderline inclusion: motor-vehicle-in-river rescue rather than a backcountry SAR-team deployment; Colorado Parks and Wildlife performed the swift-water rescue with sheriff's deputies responding. Driver Jason Joseph Beltz, 49, of Colorado Springs, arrested for DUI after the act was found intentional. Source: Chaffee County Sheriff's Office Facebook page.
